title: Pulsed coolant flow in single-phase dielectric immersion cooling of an 18650 module: data and code
description: Processed results, reference data, OpenFOAM v2606 case template, generation and post-processing scripts, and figure/table sources for a conjugate heat-transfer study of pulsed and intermittent coolant flow in single-phase dielectric immersion cooling of a six-cell 18650 module (submitted to Applied Thermal Engineering, 2026). Code under MIT; data and figures under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE).
